findings.explanation: PO-1010 names the vendor as 'Crestline Data Services Pvt. Ltd.' while the invoice, receipt, ledger entry, and bank statement all name 'Beacon IT Consulting Pvt. Ltd.', with no change-order or vendor substitution authorization present to reconcile the difference.

The receipt (2026-09-03) and the ledger/bank payment (2026-09-10) both predate the invoice date (2026-09-20), meaning payment was recorded before the invoice was issued with no advance-payment documentation on file.
